limits: This approves the guard logic only; it does not approve training, sealed-input unsealing, native execution, merge or deletion.
Final staged/committed candidate guard must be rerun after integration and cleanup.
reasoning: Publication-only log commits before plan/lock introduction are explicitly treated as pre-freeze publication history. This does not rewrite the source scientific log.
A plan imported into an existing publication log must match both exact immutable source plan and lock bytes; an arbitrary self-consistent initial import is rejected on this route.
All later governance transitions continue through unchanged check_trees; real import, later plan mutation and incorrect initial import are covered by passing regression tests.
No CLI bypass, local approval boolean, silent plan mutation or history rewrite is added. Earlier blocked guard output can remain as transparent evidence followed by this correction.
scope: History integration only; no plan amendment or execution authorization
